name: dev.anvith.blackbox.FileWatcherService
description: Blackbox, Anvith Bhat's crash reporting library, watches saved crash reports in the background after the app initializes it. When a new report is saved, it posts a notification with options to copy, share, or view reports.
disableEffect: Disabling this stops Blackbox from watching for new reports and showing its report notifications; the app's ordinary features remain available.
